blocks.text: Reaction ka rate constant (k) neeche diye gaye do tareeqon se nikala ja sakta hai:

blocks.caption: Dono tareeqe ek nazar mein
rows: Maloom concentrations par shuru ki (initial) rate
k = rate / (rate equation ki concentrations ka hasil-e-zarb)

blocks.prompt: Second order reaction ka k nikalne ke liye kaun sa tareeqa kaam aayega, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Initial concentration wala tareeqa, kyun ke yeh har order ke liye chalta hai: maloom concentrations par shuru ki rate napein aur rate equation ki concentration terms se divide karein. k = 0.693 / t₁/₂ sirf first order reactions ke liye hai.

items: k ke do raste: initial rates (koi bhi order) aur half-life, k = 0.693 / t₁/₂ (first order).
